record.question: Which government body deals with food safety, which directly affects public health?
record.explanation: Answer D: FSSAI. The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India is the statutory food-safety regulator. Reference: https://www.fssai.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
